intro_md: 🎧 **6 min.** Nam reads his message out loud (he's sending a voice message!). Listen first, then check with the words.

parts.title: Voice message
parts.md:
**Train your ears – the words are hidden at first:**
1. 👂 **Listen without the words.** Just follow. Missed a word? Keep going – the next sentence often explains it.
2. 👂 **Listen again**, still without the words. You'll catch more.
3. 📄 **Show transcript** – listen + read. **Tap any line** you missed to hear just that part again.
4. 👂 **Hide it** and listen one last time.

listen.text: Hi Mum, sorry I didn't call this week. It's been really busy!
Don't worry, I'm fine. The job is good, although I'm still getting used to everything.
My manager, Claire, is very kind. On my first day she told me not to worry about being late, because the trains here are terrible.
Most days it rains, but people don't seem to care.
My colleague Tom talks very fast. I understand about half of what he says!
He showed me around the office, and he says it takes a while to get the hang of everything.
I also met my neighbours. Margaret lives downstairs and knows everyone on the street.
Mr Patel lives in Flat 3. I helped him carry a TV up the stairs.
It was heavier than it looked!
There's a little café on the corner. Jess, who works there, already remembers my order.
In other words, I'm starting to feel at home.
I'll call you on Sunday. Love, Nam.

parts.title: Quick check + how was it?
parts.md: A few quick questions – tap an answer, you see right away if it's right. Then tell me how much you understood, ask me anything below, and 📤 **Submit**.

questions.q: How much of what Tom says does Nam understand?

check.why: *I understand about half of what he says!*
*Margaret lives downstairs* – Mr Patel is in Flat 3.

questions.q: How much did you understand? Write a number, e.g. 80
